presentation: [Chains of Despair] Nightmare Salos has a skill which can deal great damage against enemies affected by Cursed Chains.

union.description: Increases HP-related stats of allies with a Unity effect by 15 % and decreases their Defense-related stats by [FFAE00]5%[-].\n[00D5FF](HP-related Stats Increase effect is enhanced based on Ultimate Move level)[-]

passif.description:
All stats of [00D5FF]Applicable Allies[-] increase by [FFAE00]4%[-] and their [00D5FF]damage taken[-] decreases by [FFAE00]20%[-] for [FFAE00]each[-] one participating in battle.
[i][C0C0C0]※Applicable Ally: Unknown race, [Sacrifice], [The Seven Catastrophes][-][/i]

Grants themself and the [00D5FF][Sacrifice][-] or the [00D5FF][The Seven Catastrophes] ally with the highest HP[-] [00D5FF]Chains of the Covenant[-] at the start of the battle.
[i][C0C0C0]※Chains of the Covenant: All stats [FFAE00]+10%[-].
Increases basic stats by [FF8000]50%[-] of Salos's initial stats.
Decreases final damage taken by [FF8000]40%[-] when taking damage from an enemy's skill.
Immune to stat decreases.[-][/i]

When an ally with [00D5FF]Chains of the Covenant[-] uses a skill on an enemy, or if an enemy uses a skill on that ally, the enemy is inflicted with [00D5FF]Cursed Chains[-] for [FFAE00]1 turn[-].
[i][C0C0C0]※Cursed Chains: Attack-related stats [FFAE00]-20%[-] (Stacks [FFAE00]3 times[-])[-][/i]

When an ally with [00D5FF]Chains of the Covenant[-] attacks an enemy afflicted with [00D5FF]Cursed Chains[-], their Attack-related stats increase by [FFAE00]30%[-].

Inflicts additional damage equal to [FF8000]600%[-] of the target's increased Defense when the hero uses a skill.
